reason: The paper routes recommendation examples between a cheap fast path and a more expensive refinement path, evaluates selector routing and an accuracy–efficiency tradeoff, and reports normalized step-based inference cost rather than wall-clock latency. It is a concrete compute-allocation method for sequential recommendation, but does not study LLM inference/serving; relevance to the LLM inference-time-scaling line is adjacent and needs a workload/lineage check.
title: Recommender System as Slow and Fast Thinkers
